description: The enacting clause each state's or territory's bills must carry, as its constitution or statute prescribes. Read by the legislature module for a bill's form.

US-AL.text: Be it enacted by the legislature of Alabama,

US-AK.text: Be it enacted by the Legislature of the State of Alaska.

US-AZ.text: Be it enacted by the Legislature of the State of Arizona,

US-AR.text: Be it enacted by the General Assembly of the State of Arkansas.

US-CA.text: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:
US-CA.citation: Cal. Stats. (enacting clause of current chaptered statutes); not located in the Constitution text
US-CA.source: Could not read a California constitutional or statutory prescription (leginfo and Justia blocked); wording confirmed from the secondary Enacting clause listing that cites the Statutes of California. Replace with the citation from leginfo.

US-GU.source: P.L. 24-165 removed the words "territory of" from the clause; a 2006 public law (P.L. 28-138) opens with this clause. The statute text itself was not opened.

US-AS.source: UNSURE: no American Samoa public law or constitution text with the clause could be opened; wording is a best guess from the other territories' form. Verify against a current public law.

US-MP.text: Be it enacted by the Twenty-Fourth Northern Marianas Commonwealth Legislature:
US-MP.source: Read from this enrolled public law. The ordinal changes with each Legislature (24th serves 2025-2027), so the module should build it from the sitting Legislature's number.
